title: Modules and Retrievers
summary: This module encompasses the core prediction strategies and retrieval mechanisms within DSPy, enabling advanced language model interactions and efficient information fetching.

nodes.label: Prediction Modules
nodes.title: Prediction Modules
nodes.description: Provides various advanced prediction strategies and techniques, including aggregation methods, multi-turn reasoning agents (ReAct, Avatar, RLM), and program-of-thought execution, to enhance the reliability and performance of language model outputs.

nodes.label: Retrieval Modules
nodes.title: Retrieval Modules
nodes.description: Provides various retrieval mechanisms, including local and remote ColBERTv2 implementations, Databricks Vector Search, and Weaviate, to fetch relevant passages for a given query.

nodes.label: Signature Management
nodes.title: Signature Management
nodes.description: Defines and manages the structure of DSPy signatures, handling field definitions, type conversions, and metadata for language model interactions.

nodes.label: Program Execution & Primitives
nodes.title: Program Execution and Primitives
nodes.description: Defines the foundational classes for building DSPy programs, including the base module for parameter management and the core module for program logic and execution.

nodes.label: Language Model Integration
nodes.title: Language Model Integration
nodes.description: Manages interactions with various language models, including client configurations, API calls, and caching mechanisms.

nodes.label: Tool and Adapter Integration
nodes.title: Tool and Adapter Integration
nodes.description: Provides mechanisms for integrating external tools and defining custom adapters to interface with Language Models (LMs).

groups.label: Core Functionality
groups.title: Core Functionality
groups.description: The primary components for generating predictions and retrieving relevant information within DSPy programs.

groups.label: Foundational Dependencies
groups.title: Foundational Dependencies
groups.description: Modules providing the basic building blocks and structural definitions for DSPy programs and their components.

groups.label: External Integrations
groups.title: External Integrations
groups.description: Modules responsible for connecting DSPy with external language models and various tools/adapters.
